ValidationRule.description: R-G12: an in-kind gift is goods rather than money, so its amount is zero and no money rollup, report or dashboard treats it as cash. Its worth is on Fair Market Value (ADR-0030).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An in-kind gift has no amount, because goods are not money the organization holds. Leave Amount at zero and put what the goods were worth in Fair Market Value. A gift that was part money and part goods is two gifts.
